metadata.title: That 2 kill spree where my aim took a nap but Valorant said ‘Hold my mouse’ LOL
metadata.description:
Wait, I barely aimed and still got 2 kills?
Valorant’s logic is cheating and I’m here for it.
Click if your best plays feel like pure accident chaos!

Tap if your aim was AFK but kills still happen!

#valorant #gamingfails #luckshot #funnygaming #shorts
